hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.enrichmentShort: AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Marketing/Service hubs for growing teams.
limitations: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.

Sales Hub Professional starts at $100/month per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows $90/mo/seat billed annually vs $100 monthly, plus required Professional onboarding ($1,500). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).
Full GTM stack (Marketing Hub, Service Hub, etc.) is sold as additional hubs with their own seat/contact pricing — not included in Free CRM alone.

getresponse.name: GetResponse
getresponse.enrichmentShort: GetResponse is an AI-driven email marketing and lifecycle automation platform with newsletters, automation workflows, landing pages, funnels, webinars (higher plans), and ecommerce tools. Paid plans use contact-list tiers with unlimited monthly email sends; a forever-free plan and 14-day premium trial are published.
limitations: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses
Free plan heavily limited after 14-day premium window (branding, LP visits, automation filters)
SMS, dedicated IP/domain, and some enterprise tools require Enterprise

keap.name: Keap
keap.enrichmentShort: Small-business CRM with marketing automation, email/SMS campaigns, payments, and sales pipeline workflows.
limitations: Base plans start at $249/mo annually for two users; additional users are $39/mo each.
Contact capacity and voice/SMS allotments scale by Max tier; overages apply for texts/voice minutes.
Annual contracts may include a documented early-termination fee ($299) if cancelled before term end.

capsule.name: Capsule
capsule.enrichmentShort: Simple small-business CRM for contacts, sales pipelines, tasks, and lightweight automation without enterprise complexity.
limitations: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.
Workflow automations and advanced reporting start at Growth; enrichment at Advanced.
Not a marketing automation or sales-engagement suite — email templates ≠ full campaign platform.
